blocks.text: This Short Term Rental Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{date}}, by and between:
Host rents to Guest the following property:

items: Security deposit to be refunded within {{deposit_refund_period}} days after check-out, less any deductions.
Use the property solely for residential purposes and not for business, commercial, or illegal activities.
Comply with all House Rules set forth in Section 5.
Not exceed {{maximum_occupancy}} guests in the property.
Not disturb neighbors or engage in excessive noise.
Keep the property clean and sanitary.
Not damage, deface, or destroy the property or any fixtures, furniture, or appliances.
Not make any alterations or improvements without Host's consent.
Not host parties, events, or gatherings without prior written approval.
Secure the property and not allow unauthorized access.
Report any damage, malfunction, or issues to Host promptly.
Leave the property in the same condition as at check-in (normal wear and tear excepted).
No smoking inside the property; designated smoking area: {{smoking_area}}
No pets unless approved in writing by Host.
No parties, events, or large gatherings.
Provide the property in a clean, safe, and habitable condition.
Ensure all necessary repairs are completed before Guest's arrival.
Provide accurate information about the property and amenities.
Provide working smoke detectors, carbon monoxide detectors (where applicable), and fire extinguisher.
Comply with all local laws, regulations, and licensing requirements.
Deposit will be refunded within {{deposit_refund_period}} days after check-out.
Host may deduct from the deposit for: damage beyond normal wear and tear, excessive cleaning required, missing items, violations of House Rules, unpaid fees.
Host must provide an itemized list of deductions with supporting documentation.
Guest cancellation more than {{cancellation_refund_days}} days before check-in: {{cancellation_refund_percent}}% refund of rental amount.
Guest cancellation {{cancellation_partial_days}}–{{cancellation_refund_days}} days before check-in: {{cancellation_partial_percent}}% refund.
Guest cancellation less than {{cancellation_partial_days}} days before check-in: No refund.
If Host cancels, Guest receives a full refund plus compensation of {{host_cancellation_compensation}}.

blocks.text: Neither Party shall be liable for failure to perform due to causes beyond reasonable control, including natural disasters, acts of God, government orders, pandemic restrictions, or similar circumstances. In such event, Party shall notify the other Party promptly.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}, County of {{governing_county}}. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of {{governing_state}}.
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, and agreements.
